EuGraph Web Console - third-party notices

This file covers the frontend bundle embedded in eugraph-server. C++ dependencies
(Drogon, trantor, jsoncpp, brotli, c-ares, OpenSSL) are covered by the project's
build documentation and their own license files.

-----------------

  Copyright (c) Neo4j, Inc.
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sigma 4.0.4               MIT          https://github.com/jacomyal/sigma.js
  Copyright (c) 2013-2026 Alexis Jacomy and contributors.

graphology 0.26.0         MIT          https://github.com/graphology/graphology
  Copyright (c) 2017-2026 Guillaume Plique and contributors.

graphology-layout-forceatlas2 0.10.1  MIT  https://github.com/graphology/graphology
  Copyright (c) 2017-2026 Guillaume Plique and contributors.

Build-time tools
----------------
Vite 8, TypeScript 5.9, Vitest 5 (MIT). These are not shipped in the bundle.

The full text of the MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses is available at
https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT and https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.
